items.doc: Spatial hash over a w×h world. Insert ids each step (after clear), then query a circle. Three separate capacities, each saturating visibly (counters, never silent): - entities cap: ids 0..cap-1; any other id (or a non-finite x, y, r) is refused, rejected; - index nodes (default cap × 4): one node per cell a body covers; past it, dropped; - query results: the caller's out buffer; ids that don't fit set missed (this query) and count in truncated (queries cut short). Size out so missed stays 0: collision results must not drop, so a game should treat any of these counters rising as a bug.
